facts.text: Drake's Bulldog Promise offers full tuition coverage for qualifying Iowa students seeking a bachelor's degree after scholarships, grants, and financial aid are applied.

sources.title: The Bulldog Promise - Drake University
sources.quote: Drake's Bulldog Promise offers full tuition coverage for qualifying Iowa students seeking a bachelor's degree. The Bulldog Promise ensures that your tuition is fully covered after scholarships, grants, and financial aid are applied
